ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the diagram, which label marks the small cavity in the cytoplasm of a cell?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a schematic diagram of a plant cell structure, with multiple letter labels and indicator lines. The indicator line of label S points to a very large light-yellow, liquid-like cavity area inside the cell, located within the cytoplasm and occupying most of the central space of the cell. Reasoning: The question asks which label corresponds to the “small cavity in the cytoplasm.” Biologically, the small cavity in the cytoplasm is called a vacuole; in plant cells, it usually appears as a larger central vacuole. In the figure, label S points to this light-yellow vacuole area, so the answer is S.
